source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 4 (PDF 49-63), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 4 (Development of Graphical User Interface (GUI)) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.
4.1 Graphical User Interface (GUI) Development with Tkinter

blocks.prompt:
1 Differentiate between a GUI and a command-line interface.
(GUI aur command-line interface mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono tareeqon ka farq table mein hai.

book_ref.quote: Tkinter is Python's built-in library for creating GUI programs.

rows: User windows, buttons, labels aur text boxes se rabta karta hai.
User commands type kar ke rabta karta hai.
Zyada user-friendly aur aasan.
Kam user-friendly; commands yaad rakhne parte hain.
Visual feedback deta hai aur pechida commands yaad rakhne ki zaroorat kam karta hai.
Pechida commands yaad rakhne parte hain.

blocks.prompt:
2 Name three places where GUI applications are widely used, and the elements a GUI uses.
(Teen jagahein likhein jahan GUI applications aam hain, aur GUI ke elements bhi.)
blocks.explanation: GUI applications desktop software, web applications aur mobile apps mein aam hain. GUI buttons, menus aur forms jaise elements istemal karta hai.

book_ref.quote: GUIs are important because they make programs easier to understand and operate

blocks.prompt:
3 Give any four features of Tkinter.
(Tkinter ki koi chaar khoobiyan likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Python ka standard GUI toolkit, pehle se install.
2. Seekhne mein aasan aur halka.
3. Event-driven programming support karta hai.
4. Chhoti se darmiyani GUI applications jaldi banane ke liye munasib.

book_ref.quote: It is suitable for building small to medium-sized GUI applications quickly and efficiently.

blocks.prompt:
4 What is the use of command=on_click in tk.Button(window, text="Click Me", command=on_click)?
(tk.Button(window, text="Click Me", command=on_click) mein command=on_click ka kya kaam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh event handling hai: button click ko on_click() function se jorta hai. Button dabane par on_click() chalta hai (kitab mein label ka text "Button Clicked!" ho jata hai).

book_ref.quote: command=on_click → event handling (button click)

blocks.prompt:
5 What is the job of tk.Tk() and window.mainloop() in a Tkinter program?
(Tkinter program mein tk.Tk() aur window.mainloop() ka kya kaam hai?)
blocks.explanation:
tk.Tk() main window banata hai, jaise window = tk.Tk().
window.mainloop() GUI chalata hai: window khuli rakh kar user ke events ka intezar karta hai. Yeh program ke aakhir mein likha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: mainloop() → runs the GUI

blocks.prompt:
6 Write two statements to create a label showing Welcome to Tkinter and place it with 10 pixels of space above and below.
(Do statements likhein jo Welcome to Tkinter dikhane wala label banayein aur upar neeche 10 pixels jagah ke saath rakhein.)
blocks.explanation:
label = tk.Label(window, text="Welcome to Tkinter")
label.pack(pady=10)
pady=10 label ke upar neeche 10 pixels jagah deta hai.

book_ref.quote: It provides a set of classes and functions to create windows, buttons, labels, entry fields

blocks.prompt:
7 Write the purpose of: (i) window.title() (ii) window.geometry("300x200").
(In ka maqsad likhein: (i) window.title() (ii) window.geometry("300x200").)
blocks.explanation:
window.title() window ko title deta hai jo title bar par nazar aata hai.
window.geometry("300x200") window ka size 300 pixels chaura aur 200 pixels uncha karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Tkinter is Python's standard GUI toolkit that comes pre-installed with the language.

blocks.prompt:
8 What are widgets? What do they allow users to do?
(Widgets kya hain? Yeh users ko kya karne dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Widgets Tkinter ke components hain jin se interactive applications banti hain, jaise windows, frames, buttons aur text fields. Yeh users ko data likhne, option chunne ya amal karne dete hain.

book_ref.quote: These widgets allow users to enter data, choose options, or perform actions.

blocks.prompt:
9 Differentiate between a window and a frame in Tkinter.
(Tkinter mein window aur frame mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Window poora interface rakhti hai; frames use hisson mein baant te hain, table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: A frame is a container used to organize and group widgets inside a GUI window.

rows: GUI application ki main screen ya container.
Window ke andar widgets ko group karne wala container.
Sab se pehle tk.Tk() se banti hai; baqi sab ki bunyad.
Window ke andar tk.Frame(window, ...) se banta hai.
Size badla aur title diya ja sakta hai.
Window ko chhote hisson mein baant ta hai, jaise top_frame aur bottom_frame.

blocks.prompt:
10 Write two statements that create a frame with a light blue background inside window and stretch it across the window.
(Do statements likhein jo window ke andar halke neele background wala frame banayein aur use window ki chaurai mein phailayein.)
blocks.explanation:
top_frame = tk.Frame(window, bg="lightblue", height=100)
top_frame.pack(fill="x")
fill="x" frame ko window ki poori chaurai mein phailata hai.

book_ref.quote: This structure improves clarity and keeps the interface well-arranged.

blocks.prompt:
11 In the frames example, what is the difference between pack(fill="x") and pack(fill="both", expand=True)?
(Frames ki misal mein pack(fill="x") aur pack(fill="both", expand=True) mein kya farq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono options jagah mukhtalif tareeqe se bharte hain, table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Frames are sections within the window that help organize content.

rows: Widget sirf chaurai mein phailta hai.
Widget chaurai aur unchai dono mein phailta hai.
top_frame ke liye (upar ki patti).
bottom_frame ke liye, jo baqi jagah le leta hai.

blocks.prompt:
12 Differentiate between a Label and an Entry field.
(Label aur Entry field mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik text dikhata hai, doosra text leta hai, table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: A Label is used to display text or messages on the screen.

rows: Screen par text ya paigham dikhata hai.
Text likhne ke liye, jaise naam ya password.
User is mein type nahin karta.
User type karta hai; program get() se text parhta hai.
Misal: tk.Label(window, text="Username")
Misal: password ke liye tk.Entry(window, show="*")

blocks.prompt:
13 Differentiate between a Menu and a Listbox.
(Menu aur Listbox mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono options dikhate hain magar alag tareeqe se, table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: A Menu provides a list of options at the top of the window.

rows: Window ke upar options ki list deta hai.
Window ke andar items ki list dikhata hai.
User kaam ke liye option chunta hai.
User list se item select karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
14 Why is show="*" used in tk.Entry(window, show="*")?
(tk.Entry(window, show="*") mein show="*" kyun likha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh password field ke liye hai: har type kiya harf * dikhta hai, is liye password screen par chhupa rehta hai. get() phir bhi asal text deta hai (1234 likhne par **** dikhta hai magar get() 1234 deta hai).

book_ref.quote: An Entry field is used to enter text, such as a name or password.

blocks.prompt:
15 Name the three layout methods of Tkinter and state in one line what each does.
(Tkinter ke teen layout methods ke naam likhein aur har aik ka kaam aik line mein.)
blocks.explanation:
pack(): widgets ko saada upar neeche ya daayen baayen rakhta hai.
grid(): widgets ko table ki tarah rows aur columns mein rakhta hai.
place(): widgets ko window par bilkul theek jagah rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Good layout management makes the interface clear and easy to use.

blocks.prompt:
16 Differentiate between grid() and place().
(grid() aur place() mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono layout methods ka farq table mein hai.

book_ref.quote: The grid() method arranges widgets in rows and columns like a table.

rows: Widgets ko table ki tarah rows aur columns mein rakhta hai.
Widgets ko window par theek jagah (x aur y) rakhta hai.
Forms aur munazzam layouts ke liye mufeed.
Zyada control deta hai magar ehtiyat se adjust karna parta hai.
Misal: button1.grid(row=0, column=0)
Misal: button1.place(x=30, y=40)

blocks.prompt:
17 Differentiate between pack() and grid().
(pack() aur grid() mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono layout methods widgets ko alag tareeqe se rakhte hain, table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: The pack() method places widgets in a simple vertical or horizontal order.

rows: Widgets ko saada upar neeche ya daayen baayen rakhta hai.
Widgets ko table ki tarah rows aur columns mein rakhta hai.
Aasan; chhoti applications ke liye acha.
Forms aur munazzam layouts ke liye mufeed.
Misal: button1.pack(pady=10)
Misal: button1.grid(row=0, column=0, padx=10, pady=20)

blocks.prompt:
18 What is the meaning of columnspan=2 in button3.grid(row=1, column=0, columnspan=2)?
(button3.grid(row=1, column=0, columnspan=2) mein columnspan=2 ka kya matlab hai?)
blocks.explanation: columnspan=2 widget ko do columns par phaila deta hai. Yahan Button 3 row 1 (doosri row) mein column 0 se shuru ho kar Button 1 aur Button 2 ke neeche dono columns gherta hai.

book_ref.quote: The place() method positions widgets at exact locations on the window

blocks.prompt:
19 Write statements to place a button named ok 50 pixels from the left and 120 pixels from the top of the window.
(Aisa statement likhein jo ok naam ke button ko window ke baayen se 50 aur upar se 120 pixels par rakhe.)
blocks.explanation:
ok = tk.Button(window, text="OK", width=8)
ok.place(x=50, y=120)
x baayen kinare se aur y upar ke kinare se faasla hai.

book_ref.quote: It gives more control but needs careful adjustment.

blocks.prompt:
20 What is a responsive interface? Why is it useful?
(Responsive interface kya hai? Yeh kyun mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: Responsive interface window ka size badalne par apni layout badal leta hai. Is se program mukhtalif screen sizes par theek chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Responsive interfaces adjust their layout when the window size changes.

blocks.prompt:
21 Give four features of a clean interface.
(Clean (saaf) interface ki chaar khoobiyan likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Achhi tarteeb wale widgets.
2. Widgets ke darmiyan kaafi jagah.
3. Saaf aur aasani se parhe jane wala text aur buttons.
4. Durust alignment aur saada design jo use user-friendly banaye.

book_ref.quote: Text and buttons should be clear and easy to read.

blocks.prompt:
22 Define an event. Give two examples.
(Event ki definition likhein. Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Event user ka aisa amal hai jis par program jawab deta hai. Misal: button click karna aur text type karna (key press bhi).

book_ref.quote: Event handling and interactivity allow a program to respond to user actions.

blocks.prompt:
23 Why is event handling important in graphical programs?
(Graphical programs mein event handling kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Event handling program ko user ke amal par jawab dene deti hai: event hone par khaas kaam hota hai. Is se application faal aur mufeed banti hai aur program ke rawaiye par control rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Event handling is important in graphical programs.

blocks.prompt:
24 Why does event-driven programming save system resources?
(Event-driven programming system ke wasail kyun bachati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke program event hone tak idle rehta hai aur har event ka function sirf usi waqt chalta hai, program har waqt nahin chalta.

book_ref.quote: The function runs only when the event happens.

blocks.prompt:
25 Write a function that reads the text of an Entry named entry and shows "Hello, " followed by it in a Label named label.
(Aisa function likhein jo entry naam ke Entry ka text parhe aur label naam ke Label mein "Hello, " ke baad dikhaye.)
blocks.explanation:
def greet():
    name = entry.get()
    label.config(text="Hello, " + name)
Ise button = tk.Button(window, text="Greet", command=greet) se jorein. Ayesha likh kar Greet dabane par label dikhata hai: Hello, Ayesha

book_ref.quote: User input is given through widgets like entry fields and buttons.

blocks.prompt:
26 In the login form, what is the role of check_login() and messagebox?
(Login form mein check_login() aur messagebox ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: check_login() Login button dabane par chalta hai; get() se username aur password parh kar check karta hai. Phir messagebox kamyabi (showinfo) ya ghalti (showerror) ka paigham dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: When the button is clicked, the program checks the entered data.

blocks.prompt:
27 In the book's login form, the user types username admin and password 4321. What happens? Give the reason.
(Kitab ke login form mein user admin aur password 4321 likhta hai. Kya hoga? Wajah dein.)
blocks.explanation: Error ka message box "Invalid Username or Password" aata hai. Check username == "admin" and password == "1234" hai; and mein dono sach hone chahiyein, aur 4321, 1234 nahin.

book_ref.quote: A simple login form allows a user to enter a username and password.

blocks.prompt:
28 Give two advantages of using databases in Python programs.
(Python programs mein databases ke do faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Databases bohat zyada maloomat ko efficiently sambhalte aur jaldi nikalte hain.
2. Yeh data ki durustagi aur yaksaniyat barqarar rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Python supports database operations through built-in and external libraries.

blocks.prompt:
29 Define a database. Give two benefits.
(Database ki definition likhein. Do faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Database munazzam shakal mein rakha gaya data ka majmooa hai, jis se data aasani se hasil aur manage hota hai. Faide: dohrao kam aur aitbaar zyada (aur mehfooz storage).

book_ref.quote: It allows data to be accessed and managed easily.

blocks.prompt:
30 Name the four basic database concepts that describe stored data, with one example each.
(Data ko bayan karne wale chaar bunyadi database concepts ke naam aur har aik ki misal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Entity: Student.
Attribute: Roll Number (Student ka).
Relationship: Student enrols in a Course.
Identifier: Roll Number, har talib-e-ilm ka munfarid.

book_ref.quote: They support secure storage of information.

blocks.prompt:
31 Differentiate between an entity and an attribute, with examples.
(Entity aur attribute mein misalon ke saath farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Attribute entity ko bayan karta hai, table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: It describes specific information about an entity.

rows: Haqeeqi cheez, shakhs, jagah, waqia ya tasawwur jis ka data rakha jaye.
Entity ki khoobi ya sifat.
Yeh khud woh cheez hai.
Yeh entity ki khaas maloomat batata hai.
Misal: Student, Teacher, Course, Book, Employee.
Student ke liye misal: Student Name, Roll Number, Class, Age.

blocks.prompt:
32 What is a relationship? Give an example from the chapter.
(Relationship kya hai? Chapter se misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Relationship batata hai ke do ya zyada entities aapas mein kaise juri hain. Misal: A Student enrols in a Course; "enrols in" Student aur Course ka relationship hai.

book_ref.quote: A relationship shows how two or more entities are connected with each other.

blocks.prompt:
33 What is an identifier? Why can Student Name not be a good identifier?
(Identifier kya hai? Student Name acha identifier kyun nahin?)
blocks.explanation: Identifier woh attribute hai jo entity ke har record ko alag pehchane, jaise Student ke liye Roll Number, kyunke har roll number munfarid hai. Naam munfarid nahin: do talaba ka aik naam ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Roll Number can be used as an identifier because each student has a unique roll number

blocks.prompt:
34 Differentiate between a primary key and a foreign key.
(Primary key aur foreign key mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono keys ke kaam alag hain, table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Primary Key: A unique identifier for each record in a table.

rows: Table ke har record ki munfarid pehchan.
Aik table ko doosre se jorne wali field.
Apne hi table ki hoti hai.
Doosre table ki primary key ka hawala deti hai.
Misal: students table mein id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY.
Relational database mein mutaliqa tables jorne ke liye.

blocks.prompt:
35 Define a table. What are its rows and columns called?
(Table ki definition likhein. Is ki rows aur columns kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Table mutaliqa data ka majmooa hai jo rows aur columns mein hota hai. Rows records aur columns fields kehlate hain.

book_ref.quote: Table: A collection of related data organised in rows (records) and columns (fields).

blocks.prompt:
36 Why is a database connection needed in a Python program?
(Python program mein database connection kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kisi bhi data operation se pehle connection zaroori hai. Jurne ke baad data add, retrieve ya modify ho sakta hai, aur theek connection Python aur database ka rabta hamwar rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Python provides libraries that help establish this connection easily.

blocks.prompt:
37 What is a relational database?
(Relational database kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Relational database data ko rows aur columns wale tables mein rakhta hai; har table mutaliqa data rakhta hai aur tables ka taluq keys se qaim rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Relational databases organize data into tables made of rows and columns.

blocks.prompt:
38 What is SQL? Write its full form.
(SQL kya hai? Is ka poora naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: SQL yani Structured Query Language. Yeh databases se rabte ki zaban hai; is ke commands data create, read, update aur delete karte hain.

book_ref.quote: SQL commands help create, read, update, and delete data.

blocks.prompt:
39 Differentiate between sqlite3 and MySQL.
(sqlite3 aur MySQL mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh mukhtalif size ke databases ke liye hain, table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: The sqlite3 library is built into Python and is used for small databases.

rows: Python mein built-in; chhote databases ke liye.
Bade aur pechida database systems ke liye.
Data system par aik file mein (jaise school.db).
Connection database ka naam aur credentials de kar banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
40 Write the statements to import sqlite3 and connect to a database file named library.db. What happens if the file does not exist?
(sqlite3 import karne aur library.db naam ki database file se jurne ke statements likhein. File na ho to kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
import sqlite3
connection = sqlite3.connect("library.db")
Agar library.db na ho to SQLite use khud bana deta hai. Kamyab connection Python ko database tak rasai deta hai.

book_ref.quote: A successful connection allows Python to access the database.

blocks.prompt:
41 What is a cursor? Write the statement that creates it.
(Cursor kya hai? Ise banane wala statement likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Cursor aik object hai jo jure hue database par SQL queries chalata hai.
cursor = connection.cursor()

book_ref.quote: Create Cursor: Creates a cursor object to execute SQL commands.

blocks.prompt:
42 What does fetchall() return? Show with a short program.
(fetchall() kya deta hai? Chhote program se dikhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
fetchall() pichhli query ki tamam rows (records) ki list deta hai; har row tuple hoti hai.
import sqlite3
connection = sqlite3.connect("school.db")
cursor = connection.cursor()
cursor.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS students (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, age INTEGER, grade TEXT)")
cursor.execute("INSERT INTO students (name, age, grade) VALUES ('Hina', 16, '11th')")
connection.commit()
cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM students")
print(cursor.fetchall())
connection.close()
Output:
[(1, 'Hina', 16, '11th')]

book_ref.quote: Fetch and Display Data: Fetches all records and prints each row in the result.

blocks.prompt:
43 How does Python execute an SQL command? Write a statement that creates a table named books with columns id, title and price.
(Python SQL command kaise chalata hai? books naam ka table banane ka statement likhein jis mein id, title aur price columns hon.)
blocks.explanation:
Python SQL commands cursor ke execute() se database ko bhejta hai:
cursor.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS books (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, price INTEGER)")

book_ref.quote: Executing SQL commands allows Python programs to manage database data effectively.

blocks.prompt:
44 Write the SQL command used for each CRUD operation.
(Har CRUD operation ki SQL command likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Create: INSERT
Read: SELECT
Update: UPDATE
Delete: DELETE

book_ref.quote: These operations are used to manage data stored in a database

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Table 4.1 ke Command column mein Read ke saamne 'READ' chhapa hai, magar SQL mein READ naam ki koi command nahin; Read operation SELECT se hota hai, jaisa usi row ki misal SELECT * FROM students; dikhati hai.

blocks.prompt:
45 Write an SQL statement to add a student with ID 5, Name Usman and Age 17 to the students table.
(students table mein ID 5, Name Usman aur Age 17 wala talib-e-ilm shamil karne ka SQL statement likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
INSERT INTO students (ID, Name, Age) VALUES (5, 'Usman', 17);
Yeh Create operation hai; table mein naya record dalta hai.

book_ref.quote: SQL insert commands are used for this purpose.

blocks.prompt:
46 Write an SQL statement to retrieve all records of the students table. Does it change the data?
(students table ke tamam records nikalne ka SQL statement likhein. Kya yeh data badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
SELECT * FROM students;
* tamam columns chunta hai. Yeh Read operation hai aur stored data nahin badalta.

book_ref.quote: SQL select commands are commonly used for reading data.

blocks.prompt:
47 Write an SQL statement to change the age of the student with ID 3 to 19. Why is WHERE needed?
(ID 3 wale talib-e-ilm ki umar 19 karne ka SQL statement likhein. WHERE kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation:
UPDATE students SET Age = 19 WHERE ID = 3;
WHERE shart deta hai, is liye sirf ID 3 wala record badalta hai; is ke baghair har record ki Age badal jati.

book_ref.quote: Python executes these commands based on conditions.

blocks.prompt:
48 Differentiate between the Create and Update operations.
(Create aur Update operations mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik naya data dalta hai, doosra maujooda data badalta hai, table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: The Update operation changes existing data in a database.

rows: Table mein naya data (naya record) dalta hai.
Maujooda data badalta hai.
SQL INSERT command.
Shart ke saath SQL UPDATE command.
Misal: INSERT INTO students (ID, Name, Age) VALUES (1, 'John', 20);
Misal: UPDATE students SET Age = 21 WHERE ID = 1;

blocks.prompt:
49 What is the purpose of connection.commit() in the delete example?
(Delete ki misal mein connection.commit() ka kya maqsad hai?)
blocks.explanation: connection.commit() tabdeeliyan database mein save karta hai. commit() ke baghair deletion pakki nahin hoti: connection band hone par record wahin rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: It helps keep the database clean and accurate.

blocks.prompt:
50 Find the output of this program.
(Is program ka output likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
import sqlite3
connection = sqlite3.connect("school.db")
cursor = connection.cursor()
cursor.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS students (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, age INTEGER, grade TEXT)")
cursor.execute("INSERT INTO students (name, age, grade) VALUES ('Ali', 14, '8th')")
cursor.execute("INSERT INTO students (name, age, grade) VALUES ('Sara', 15, '9th')")
cursor.execute("DELETE FROM students WHERE id = 1")
connection.commit()
cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM students")
print(cursor.fetchall())
connection.close()
Output:
[(2, 'Sara', 15, '9th')]
Sirf id 1 (Ali) wala record hat-ta hai.

book_ref.quote: The Delete operation removes unwanted data from a database.

blocks.prompt:
51 Differentiate between connection.commit() and connection.close().
(connection.commit() aur connection.close() mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono connection par chalte hain magar kaam alag hai, table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: connection.commit() → saves the changes in database

rows: Tabdeeliyan (insert, update, delete) database mein save karta hai.
Kaam ke baad database connection band karta hai.
Is ke baghair deletion jaisi tabdeeli pakki nahin hoti.
Aakhir mein, kaam (aur commit) ke baad likha jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
52 Why should the Delete operation be used carefully?
(Delete operation ehtiyat se kyun istemal karna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Delete database se records hata deta hai. Ise shart ke saath chalana chahiye taake sirf chune hue records hatein; ehtiyat ahem data ko zaya hone se bachati hai.

book_ref.quote: The Delete operation is used to remove records from a database safely.
